ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface, with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips; estimated low-to-high intensity ratio of 15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark region across the entire visible ventral fluke area; no high-contrast mottling or internal geometric blobs detected; distinct high-contrast white clusters localized only at the terminal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an obtuse angle of approximately 115 degrees; moderate depth relative to the horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary with irregular frequency; peaks and valleys are more pronounced and of higher amplitude on the distal half of the left lobe (viewer perspective) compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular white pixels concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of high-contrast white epibiotic formations (barnacles) at both distal lobe tips; no visible gross amputations or major traumatic tissue loss.
